description: [WORD · internal] The original-language words behind a verse (Hebrew/Greek, with Strong's where known) — FOUND in the lexicon, never generated. Returns the tagged words AND coverage {tagged, total, untagged_positions, untagged_words, complete}: the tagged words are not the whole verse (Greek ~44% tagged, Hebrew ~98%), and the untagged words are shown, never dropped. Pass ref, e.g. 'John 3:16'.
name: original_words
